title: Geisha and Dragonfly Pagoda
description: A woman in traditional Japanese kimono and red parasol ascends a long, winding wooden staircase toward a multi-tiered red pagoda. The scene is set at twilight with a giant green moon, vibrant aurora borealis, oversized dragonflies, red chrysanthemum trees, and a reflective lake at the base of the hill.
prompt: A woman in ornate red and white kimono holding a red parasol climbs a long mossy staircase toward a multi-tiered traditional Japanese pagoda. Giant dragonflies with iridescent wings fly near a glowing green moon and vibrant purple-green aurora borealis in the night sky. Red chrysanthemum trees grow on the hillside beside a calm reflective lake, in a mystical surreal style with rich colors and intricate details.
